    Where is the player championship in 2026?
    An AI Overview is not available for this searchCan't generate an AI overview right now. Try again later.
    AI Overview
    The 2026 Players Championship is being held at the Stadium Course at TPC Sawgrass in Ponte Vedra Beach, Florida, the traditional home of the event, with play commencing in mid-March 2026. This PGA Tour event features the world's best golfers testing their skills on the famously challenging course, known for its island green on the 17th hole.
     
    Key Details:
    • Location: TPC Sawgrass (Stadium Course). 
    • City: Ponte Vedra Beach, Florida. 
    • Timing: Mid-March (typically the second week of March). 
    • Significance: It's considered the PGA Tour's flagship event, often called the "fifth major," due to its strong field and high stakes.
